description: Lists what went wrong in the user's tab: frames that failed to render (with the frame and the engine's message), a preview that stopped moving and why, compositions that would not load, clips that will not decode, missing footage, failed exports, a page the browser killed — plus warnings. Works while the tab is hidden or closed. `current` belongs to the composition as it is now; `earlier` counts problems an edit has since left behind. Other tool results may also carry a `problems` list of what is new. An empty list covers only what the tab has played; check_playback does a full pass.

id.description: Only this composition. Omit for all of them.

token.description: The session token that connect returned.
